verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus publishes an API reference with per-endpoint pages (bulk contact updates, campaign reports, list fields). Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec that would typically power such a console. A static reference is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
